Class PlotParameters

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.plot.PlotParameters
public class PlotParameters extends Object
A centralized, mutable set of visual and behavioral parameters used by a PlotCanvas.

Fluent API: All mutator methods (methods that change internal state) return this so calls can be chained, e.g. 

params.setPlotTitle("My Plot").setXLabel("t (s)").setYLabel("V (m/s)").mustIncludeYZero(true).setLegendDrawing(true);
